title: Deliverance and Breakthrough
content:
Dearly beloved,

The theme for this month’s devotional is Deliverance and Breakthrough.

So David went to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there; and he said, ‘The Lord has broken through my enemies before me, like a breakthrough of water.’ Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim. – 2 Samuel 5:20 (NKJV)

Throughout the Bible, we are reminded that our God is the God of deliverance – the One who rescues, restores and makes a way where there seems to be none. He is also the God of breakthrough, who causes His children to press through barriers and step into new dimensions of victory and manifestation.

Deliverance and breakthrough are not merely occasional experiences in the life of the believer; they are part of the inheritance we have in Christ. God desires for us to walk in freedom, overcome every resistance of the enemy, and continually advance into the fullness of His purpose for our lives.

This month, God wants to strengthen our faith, renew our perspective, and position us for supernatural intervention in every area where we need His hand to move. No barrier is too strong, no challenge is too great, and no situation is beyond His power to transform.

Beloved, as you journey through these devotionals, my prayer is that every chain of limitation will be broken, every hindrance standing in your way will give way, and that you will experience divine deliverance and remarkable breakthroughs that reveal the power and faithfulness of God in your life.

Be blessed as you read.

Much Love,

Pastor Andy
author: Dr. Andy Osakwe
